reason: The evaluator can now save honest note-only observations, distinguish persistence from canonical qualifying evidence, and identify missing required observations and coverage. That current task defect prevents world-class agreement and warrants holding this revision. findings.evidence: save waits on inflight at line 149, then awaits retryOnNetworkError(authorizedFetch(...)) at 157-161 and response.json at 162 without a deadline or AbortSignal. finish releases the per-applicant queue only in finally at 178-179. client-fetch.ts authorizedFetch has no overall deadline; retryOnNetworkError only retries rejected requests. Retry/copy guidance in the roster renders only for error/hint, not saving. The supplied group-case-evidence.spec.ts covers rejected and malformed responses, but no permanently stalled request/body.
findings.userImpact: A connection/body stall leaves Saving… indefinitely. Subsequent scores and notes for that applicant wait behind the unresolved request, so observations remain only in the page without reaching normal retry guidance. This is a source-derived failure mode, not an observed hosted incident.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the complete Group Case request/body lifecycle, release the queue on timeout, preserve the latest payload and announce an unconfirmed outcome with copy/retry guidance. Add stalled-request and stalled-body checks followed by a newer observation, ensuring stale receipts cannot mark it saved.
